name: Brass: Birmingham

rounds.endCondition: Canal Era and Rail Era each end after all players use their last cards

categories.label: Final VP (score track)
categories.hint: VP marker after the Rail Era scoring; add 100 per lap. Link and industry VP are scored onto the track at the end of each era; shortfall penalties are already deducted.

categories.label: Income level (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Income level number, not income track space.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, those players draw.

notes: VPs are only awarded at the end of each era (links first, then flipped industries; unflipped industries score nothing). Link tiles are removed as scored; level-1 industries are removed after canal era. If you enter the final VP marker position instead, use one number per era. Beyond 100 VP the track loops. Per-player scorers can record era subtotals via the four categories. Final score is the VP marker on the track: era scoring (links, flipped industries) and shortfall penalties move it during play, so no per-link or per-industry entry is needed.
